text:
Because I lost, in sterile chances,

that warm and ripened image

which nature gave me of itself,

entangled in Your voice and Your embraces.


Not even the murmur of Your steps;

nothing now endures inside the heart;

You have become a "Perhaps" in my blackness

and emptied Yourself of being between my arms.


A universe without cardinal points,

the black wind of Genesis supplants

that blond waving of the wheatfields.


And a vertigo of shadow rises

there where Your angelic torrents

perhaps set down their serene foot.

translation.title: Because I Lost, in Sterile Chances
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the capitalized devotional You and the loss of a once ripened divine image.
